SELECT
    nexus_constitution.record_nexus_event(
        p_event_name       => 'n8n Workflow 007 Event Ledger Orchestration Verification',
        p_event_type       => 'SYNC_CONFIRMED',
        p_source_system    => 'N8N',
        p_source_record_id => '{{ $json.source_record_id }}',
        p_actor_type       => 'N8N',
        p_actor_id         => 'nexus_n8n_runtime',
        p_outcome_status   => 'VERIFIED',
        p_idempotency_key  => '{{ $json.idempotency_key }}',
        p_state            => 'VERIFIED',
        p_evidence         => 'Workflow 007 recorded a governed Nexus event through the approved PostgreSQL gateway.',
        p_decision         => 'Accept the event only after governed readback and replay return the same event ID.',
        p_next_action      => 'Read back the event, verify the payload, replay the same idempotency key, and issue a receipt.',
        p_previous_state   => '{"workflow_007":"UNVERIFIED"}'::jsonb,
        p_new_state        => '{"workflow_007":"RECORDED","orchestration":"IN_PROGRESS"}'::jsonb
    ) AS event_id,
    '{{ $json.idempotency_key }}'::text AS idempotency_key;
